feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Iteration 1 (50 mm span, base_speed 1.4, kp 4.0, kd 0.3) ran off track on all 60 trials, with progress 0.11 to 0.16, max_error about 0.063 to 0.067, and line_loss_events of 2.0 on the oval and 1.0 on the s-bend and slalom. The 50 mm span did not eliminate line loss, which is the condition for the Integrator's forward-array rule. The controller is unchanged from iteration 1 so this geometry change can be read alone. Next race: if line_loss_events is still at least 1 on any track at y = 0.055 m, try moving the array to about y = 0.06 to 0.065 m and keep the span. If line_loss_events is 0 on all tracks but max_error stays at or above 0.06 and the robot still leaves the track, the limit is turning authority, so try a narrower wheel_track (about 0.10 m) for more turn rate per wheel difference. Keep body_width at 0.12 m, because the off-track limit is already at its 0.06 m floor and widening the body does not change it.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events is still at least 1 on any development track at y = 0.055 m, move the array forward to about y = 0.06 to 0.065 m, keeping the 50 mm span (iteration 1 showed 1 to 2 losses per track at y = 0.04 m).

If line_loss_events drops to 0 but max_error stays at about 0.06 or more and the robot still leaves the track, reduce wheel_track from 0.12 m to about 0.10 m to increase turn rate (iteration 1 max_error was 0.063 to 0.067).
Keep body_width at 0.12 m; the off-track limit is already at the 0.06 m floor (iteration 1 max_error 0.063 to 0.067), so body width does not change the outcome.
